heading: The Northern Crusades
source_blocks.text: The Northern Crusades

heading: The Northern Crusades
source_blocks.text: The largest and most politically favored branch of the Fourth Imperium.

heading: The Northern Crusades
source_blocks.text: These forces lead the great reconquest campaigns into Ecuador, Colombia, and Venezuela, pushing against UNMC strongholds and corporate enclaves. They are disciplined conquerors, built for territorial war, objective seizure, and the relentless forward grind of holy expansion.

heading: The Northern Crusades
source_blocks.text: Trait: Righteous Advance – When attacking an enemy unit that is contesting or controlling an objective, reroll 1 failed hit.

records.label: The Host of Completion
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The Host of Completion
source_blocks.text: The Host of Completion

heading: The Host of Completion
source_blocks.text: The most feared of the Imperial arms.

heading: The Host of Completion
source_blocks.text: The Host of Completion believes true sanctity is found in nearness to death and the willing offering of the self in battle. Its assault mechs are built for brutal charges, close combat, and decisive acts of sacrificial violence. To them, distance preserves the self — and completion demands contact.

heading: The Host of Completion
source_blocks.text: Trait: Completion Through Contact – +1 ME when charging.

records.label: The Eastern Vigil
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The Eastern Vigil
source_blocks.text: The Eastern Vigil

heading: The Eastern Vigil
source_blocks.text: Wardens of the oceanic frontier.

heading: The Eastern Vigil
source_blocks.text: Stationed along the Imperium’s eastern approaches, the Eastern Vigil watches the sea lanes toward Africa and the unknown horrors beyond. Their forces are dour, conservative, and accustomed to hunting threats too large, too strange, or too unnatural to fit neatly inside Imperial doctrine.

heading: The Eastern Vigil
source_blocks.text: Trait: Watchfire Discipline – If this unit did not move this activation, reroll 1 failed ranged hit. If the target has STR 5+ or Fly, that attack also gains AP +1.

records.label: The Synod of the First Measure
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The Synod of the First Measure
source_blocks.text: The Synod of the First Measure

heading: The Synod of the First Measure
source_blocks.text: The doctrinal heart of the empire.

heading: The Synod of the First Measure
source_blocks.text: Drawn from Neuform and the institutions closest to the Ascendant, the Synod interprets purity law, judges worthiness, and enforces the Imperium’s sacred standard. Its mech formations are highly controlled, disciplined, and often reserved for command roles, exemplars, and the correction of heresy within the ranks.

heading: The Synod of the First Measure
source_blocks.text: Trait: Measured Authority – Once per round, a friendly Fourth Imperium unit within 10 cm of one or more Synod units may reroll a failed morale, suppression, or command roll.

records.label: The World-Treaders
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The World-Treaders
source_blocks.text: The World-Treaders

heading: The World-Treaders
source_blocks.text: The largest and heaviest of the Wild Hosts.

heading: The World-Treaders
source_blocks.text: Their Warforms are vast, brutal, and built for direct territorial denial. When an invasion must be broken by raw force, the World-Treaders answer with enormous living engines that crash through gunlines and fortified positions alike.

records.label: The Crown of Ash
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The Crown of Ash
source_blocks.text: The Crown of Ash

heading: The Crown of Ash
source_blocks.text: Ancient, saurian, and deeply feared even within the Dominion.

heading: The Crown of Ash
source_blocks.text: This Host fields Warforms that seem less like grown weapons and more like living catastrophes dredged from the world’s oldest memory. Slow, terrible, and relentless, they embody the wrath of the deep earth.

records.label: The Veiled Pulse
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The Veiled Pulse
source_blocks.text: The Veiled Pulse

heading: The Veiled Pulse
source_blocks.text: Fast, precise, and deeply unsettling.

heading: The Veiled Pulse
source_blocks.text: Its Warforms are more humanoid, more controlled, and more uncanny than those of the other Hosts. Many within the Dominion distrust their methods, fearing they stand too close to a path that should never have been walked — yet their loyalty and battlefield value are beyond dispute.

records.label: The Ironroot Host
records.version_basis: User identification and supplied filename; body says ALPHA

heading: The Ironroot Host
source_blocks.text: The Ironroot Host

heading: The Ironroot Host
source_blocks.text: The most divisive of the Wild Hosts.

heading: The Ironroot Host
source_blocks.text: Where others reject dead machinery, the Ironroot Host is willing to graft, bind, and repurpose limited technological remnants into living flesh. Many see them as dangerously compromised. Others see them as practical defenders willing to use any tool that still serves life.
